description: This file is a PHP script for generating and displaying reports related to test case results in the TestLink platform. It handles report initialization, data retrieval, spreadsheet creation, and output rendering for 'never run by pre-production' test cases, including support for exporting to HTML and XLS formats. The script also manages access rights, configuration, and email sending functionalities.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Class used to generate a rich HTML table with sorting and toolbar features for displaying test results.

classes.name: tlHTMLTable
classes.description: Class used to generate a plain HTML table for data display.

classes.name: PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Spreadsheet
classes.description: Third-party class from PhpSpreadsheet library for creating Excel spreadsheets.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and processes request parameters for the report, manages access rights and session info.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the graphical user interface object with labels, titles, configuration data, and platform info.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to access the test plan metrics.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Constructs the email configuration object for report notifications.

methods.name: buildMatrix
methods.description: Builds a matrix (table) for displaying test case data, supporting HTML and other formats.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates an XLS spreadsheet from report data, saves it temporarily, and handles email or download delivery.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves metrics about test cases that have never been run per platform in a specific test plan.

methods.name: xlsStepOne
methods.description: Sets up the initial rows and styles in the generated XLS spreadsheet.
